raw_text: Sudan's capital Khartoum has become a war zone as fighting between the army and the Rapid Support Forces enters its second day. The power struggle between Generals Burhan and Hemedti has plunged the country into chaos, derailing a fragile democratic transition. International mediators including the AU and UN are urgently seeking a ceasefire.
